backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a WhatsApp CTA fix to frontend/src/App.tsx with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains short summaries of key frontend files including App.tsx, index.css, and tailwind config.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining color variables, dark mode tokens, and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main UI showing two tyre product cards with WhatsApp order links and a branded header and footer.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook creating and refreshing a backend actor based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, and identity persistence wiring.
frontend/src/index.css: Theme definitions for brand colors, WhatsApp button styles, semantic tokens, and dark mode.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry point mounting App with Internet Identity and React Query providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind setup extending theme with OKLCH colors, brand tokens, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, requirements, and issues for building a responsive landing page with product cards and correct WhatsApp links. Notes HTML quoting errors, needed UI fixes, and Tailwind-based styling requirements.
